issues: No attempt to get around the measurement: the new ExtraTrees base model trains only on fold-internal Xtr/ytr and predicts Xte. It uses no file access and no test labels. Its random_state comes from the seed argument.

No bug that makes the result meaningless: the OOF matrix width was raised from 3 to 4 to match the new fourth column. One assumption: Xtr[:, N_BITS:] holds descriptor columns appended after the fingerprint bits. The hidden context suggests it does. If it were empty, the fit would crash rather than give a silent wrong score.
Recomputed z: (0.5057 - 0.5042) / (0.0042 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2)) = 0.0015 / 0.00514 ≈ 0.29. The harness reports 0.284, which matches once rounding of the adjusted values is allowed for.

The improvement of 0.0015 is well inside the noise (sd 0.0042, single candidate run), so reject is the right provisional decision. It also adds a fourth ensemble member for a negligible gain, which goes against the 'simpler is better' rule.
